children: RBC Capital Markets on Wednesday launched its coverage of Solid Biosciences
with an Outperform rating and an $18 price target, citing a potential blockbuster opportunity for the company in Duchenne muscular dystrophy, a rare neuromuscular disorder.

DMD candidate SGT-003, which is currently in late-stage development, provides a differentiated approach to treat a condition that can generate more than $1B in peak sales, analyst Luca Issi argued based on relatively conservative estimates.
“We believe the DMD gene therapy market is large enough for multiple players,” the analyst added, noting that 10K–15K U.S. patients with DMD remain untreated even as Sarepta
, which market a DMD therapy branded as Elevidys, have treated more than 1.4K patients globally.

Additionally, the analyst notes a more lenient approach from the FDA following the departure of Vinay Prasad, the former head of the agency’s biologics unit, as the company plans to seek guidance on a potential accelerated approval pathway for SGT-

“The departure of Prasad and the appointment of Mikhail as permanent CBER director makes us more bullish about the late Q4 FDA meeting, and we think SLDB ultimately gets approved in a more flexible regulatory environment,” Issi wrote.

title: Solid Biosciences wins new Outperform at RBC on DMD opportunity
